source: During training, many tokens are routed together and gradients flow through the selected expert computations and router weights. An expert receives main-task gradient only from tokens that use it on that step. Balancing and stability objectives, when present, add router-specific training signals.
zh: 在训练期间，许多令牌被一起路由，并且梯度流经选定的专家计算和路由器权重。专家仅从在该步骤中使用它的令牌接收主任务梯度。平衡和稳定性目标（如果存在）会添加特定于路由器的训练信号。
